title: Vision-language models for chest radiography do not always need the image
abstract: arXiv:2606.17710v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-language models that answer questions about chest radiographs are evaluated by their accuracy on labels derived from radiology reports. High benchmark accuracy is often interpreted as evidence that the model uses the image. A model that answers from the finding named in the question can score as well as a model that uses the radiograph. Keeping the question fixed, we audit eight open-weight systems by swapping in another patient's radiograph with the same or the opposite label, occluding the radiologist-marked region or an equal region elsewhere, and removing the radiograph or replacing it with noise or a photograph. On 2,548 yes-or-no questions from MIMIC-CXR, one multimodal model answers Yes regardless of the image, another multimodal model changes its answers without following the label, and four systems use the image but keep about half of their correct answers when the radiograph is swapped for an opposite-label rad

translated_title: 用于胸部X光片的视觉-语言模型并非总是需要图像
translated_abstract: 回答关于胸部X光片问题的视觉-语言模型，通常根据其基于放射学报告提取的标签的准确率来进行评估。高基准准确率常被解读为模型确实使用了图像的证据。然而，一个仅根据问题中提到的发现来作答的模型，其得分可以与真正使用X光片的模型一样高。在保持问题不变的前提下，我们通过以下方式对八个开放权重系统进行了审计：换入另一位具有相同或相反标签患者的X光片、遮挡放射科医生标记的区域或遮挡其他位置的等面积区域，以及移除X光片或将其替换为噪声或照片。在来自MIMIC-CXR的2,548个是非判断问题上，一个多模态模型无论图像如何都回答“是”，另一个多模态模型会改变其答案但并不遵循标签，而有四个系统确实使用了图像，但当X光片被换成相反标签的X光片时，它们仍保留了约一半的正确答案。
tldr: 该研究通过图像替换、区域遮挡和图像去除等一系列对照实验，对八个开放权重视觉-语言模型进行审计，揭示了胸部X光片问答的高基准准确率并不能证明模型真正使用了图像，部分模型仅依赖问题文本即可获得相当的成绩。
en_tdlr: Through controlled experiments swapping, occluding, and removing chest radiographs across eight open-weight vision-language models, this study shows that high benchmark accuracy does not prove the model actually uses the image, as some models can score just as well from the question text alone.
